basic_info.description: 3301 Broderick Street is a stately corner building in one of San Francisco's most desirable locations. Situated on the corner of Francisco Street, the property features nine 1bd/1ba units and three 2bd/1ba units. Tenants enter through an ornate arched entryway with large windows that provide abundant natural light throughout the hallways. Most units are south-facing and also receive excellent light. Units feature hardwood floors, highceilings, generously sized rooms, and updated kitchens and bathrooms, making them highly sought-after rentals. The property includes 9 individual garages, some accommodating two cars. A seismic retrofit was completed in 2018 and the roof was replaced in 2023. Heat is provided by a steam boiler system. This quiet residential location is just one block from Chestnut Street's shops and restaurants. Owned by the same family for almost 40 years, the property has been impeccably maintained. This is a rare opportunity to own a trophy corner asset in the Marina District.
